tasks.sub: at least 4 h, overnight is best

tasks.text: Pork & pepper stir-fry: marinate the pork strips
tasks.sub: at least 4 h, overnight is best

tasks.text: Birria beef: soak in chile liquid (braise tomorrow)
Street taco beef: mix with taco spice
tasks.sub: at least 4 h, overnight is best

tasks.text: Smash burgers: roll 75 g beef balls
Crispy chicken sandwich: cutlets in buttermilk brine
Chicken tenders: buttermilk brine
Meatballs: roll 50 g balls and let them rest
Bolognese base: cook it and chill
Bitterballen: make the beef filling and chill it
Kroket: make the beef filling and chill it
Chicken saté: marinate
Take a photo of the full fridge
Drinks in the cooler. Boxes and bags stacked by restaurant
Check every overnight container is in the fridge and labelled
tasks.sub: One missing? Remake it (needs at least 4 h) or take that dish off the menu today

tasks.text: Shrimp: start the garlic brine
tasks.sub: 4 h before service - never more than 8 h

tasks.text: Birria: braise the beef, shred it, strain the consommé
Rice cooker on: rice for Dushi Wok and Taco Brava
Cook the shared chicken (burrito, bowl, quesadilla) to 74°C
tasks.sub: Keep hot at 60°C or more - or chill to 4°C within 2 h

tasks.text: Street taco beef: cook from last night’s spice mix to 74°C
Bolognese: finish or reheat the base
Meatballs: bake at 200°C to 74°C in the middle
Sweet & sour sauce
Arrabbiata sauce: simmer 20 min
Peanut sauce for saté
tasks.sub: Peanut butter 400 g + water 300 ml + soy 40 ml + sugar 40 g + garlic 20 g + chili 5 g + lime 30 ml

tasks.text: Salsa: dice, mix, rest 15 min
Curry ketchup and mayo into labelled squeeze bottles
tasks.sub: Curry ketchup = 200 g ketchup + 15 g curry powder

tasks.text: Lo mein noodles: boil, oil, chill
Pasta for Nonna’s: water on, oiled pasta ready
Egg rolls: cook the filling, cool it, roll and seal
tasks.sub: Raw rolls keep sealed in the fridge max 24 h

tasks.text: Bitterballen: scoop, bread, chill 30 min
Kroket: shape 10 cm rolls and bread them
Saté: thread the chicken on skewers, 50 g each
Tortilla chips: cut, fry at 175°C, salt, keep dry
Garnish ready: scallion, sesame, cilantro, lime, parsley, pickles
Fries stay in the freezer until you drop them
Label every finished container and put it on its restaurant shelf

prep.title: Before you open
prep.note: Do not take orders until every box here is ticked.

tasks.text: Fryer oil at 175°C. Basket clean, spider and trays out
Griddle oiled, smash spatula ready
Wok clear. Rice hot, or a plan to reheat it
Oil thermometer and probe thermometer on the hook
Every sauce labelled
Boxes and liners stacked by restaurant
tasks.sub: Wok trays · taco trays · burger boxes · aluminium pasta trays · kraft snack trays

tasks.text: Sauce cups and lids
Napkins, forks and bags
Drinks on ice: Coca-Cola, Coke Zero, Sprite
Waterproof labels and tape at hand

close.title: Cool down and keep
close.note: Hot food you keep must reach 4°C or colder within 2 hours.

tasks.text: Spread leftover hot food thin on trays and put it in the fridge
tasks.sub: 4°C or colder within 2 h - if not, throw it away
tasks.src: Safe temperature: keep hot or chill within 2 h

tasks.text: Birria beef and consommé: chill
Cooked street taco beef: chill
Meatballs in sauce: chill
Arrabbiata sauce and peanut sauce: chill
Salsa: chill
Tortilla chips: airtight box, keep dry
Breaded bitterballen and kroket you did not fry: freeze
tasks.sub: Up to 2 weeks. Fry from frozen, +1 min

tasks.text: Marinated saté skewers: fridge
Raw rolled egg rolls: sealed in the fridge
Shrimp still in brine: do not leave it overnight
tasks.sub: Max 8 h in brine. Rinse, pat dry, cook now - do not brine again

tasks.text: All leftover fried food
tasks.sub: Fries, wings, tenders, crispy chicken, bitterballen, kroket, egg rolls

tasks.text: Anything kept hot for more than 2 hours
Shrimp fried rice and lo mein kept hot more than 1 hour
Cooked shrimp left over
Built dishes: burgers, burritos, tacos, nachos, quesadillas
Any container with no label or past its use-by
Fryer oil if it foams, is dark or smells fishy
Label everything you keep
tasks.sub: Restaurant · dish · allergens · use-by date + time · next step

tasks.text: Raw and marinating food on the bottom shelf, drip tray under it
tasks.sub: Never put ready-to-eat food under raw

tasks.text: Sauces in the door, garnish on top, each restaurant on its own shelf
Filter the fryer oil
Scrape and clean the griddle
Wash the wok, pots, pans and fryer basket
Clean the probe thermometer
Wash and sanitise boards, knives and benches
Sweep and mop the floor. Empty the bins
Start tomorrow’s night-before list
